## Key terms

## 15.1 Files and the cloud

- One **account** for Office, e-mail and the e-learning platform.
- **Folders** and good names: `2026-11-03_report.docx`.
- **Sync** copies every change (also mistakes); a **backup** keeps an extra
  copy.
- **Share** with a link only for the people who need it.

![A folder tree.](../week-01/images/folder-tree.png){width=92%}

{{< sim file="../week-03/sims/share-settings.html" poster="../week-03/sims/share-settings.png" title="Share Settings: who and what?" height="560" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Sync is not a backup: a deleted file is deleted everywhere.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Lab task · Your study folder"}
Make the folders *Digital Skills › Lab* and *Digital Skills › Online*, and
move three course files into them with good names. Then share one file with
a classmate, "can view" only.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · Files"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="Document1.docx|a link for anyone"}
Which name is best for a report of 3 November 2026?
:   2026-11-03_report.docx

What does sync do with a change on your phone?
:   it copies it to your other devices

What keeps an older copy you can go back to?
:   a backup

How does Huda share the price list with Rana only?
:   a link only for Rana
:::
:::

## 15.2 AI tools and prompts

- AI is good at drafts, summaries, rewriting, translation; it can **make up
  facts**.
- A clear **prompt**: **task**, **context**, **format**. Then a
  **follow-up**.
- **Check every answer**. Never type real personal data.

![The parts of a prompt.](../week-02/images/prompt-parts.png){width=92%}

{{< sim file="../week-02/sims/weak-spots.html" poster="../week-02/sims/weak-spots.png" title="Weak Spots: what is wrong with this AI answer?" height="640" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Read and check an AI answer before you use it.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Lab task · Prompt and check"}
Ask an AI tool for a 3-sentence notice: "The library closes at 2 pm on
Sunday." Check the answer and correct any wrong fact.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · AI"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="the name of the AI|a long story"}
Which three parts make a clear prompt?
:   task, context and format

What is a made-up fact in an AI answer called?
:   a hallucination

What must you never type into an AI tool?
:   real personal data

The answer is too long. What do you do?
:   ask a follow-up: “Make it 3 sentences.”
:::
:::

## 15.3 Word

- Formatting; **styles** (Title, Heading 1, Heading 2).
- Lists, tables, pictures with **Wrap Text**.
- Page layout; **header and footer** with page numbers; **table of
  contents** from the headings (**Update Table** after changes).
- Letter and CV: fixed parts.

![Heading styles.](../week-04/images/styles.png){width=92%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Bold text is not a heading for Word: use the heading styles.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Lab task · A short report"}
Write a one-page report with a title and three headings. Add a table of
contents and page numbers in the footer.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · Word"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="bold text|a text box"}
What does Word use to build a table of contents?
:   the heading styles

Where do page numbers go?
:   in the header or the footer

You added a heading. What do you do with the contents?
:   Update Table

How does a picture sit beside the text?
:   Wrap Text: Square
:::
:::

## 15.4 Excel

- **Formula** with =: `=B2*C2`. Relative (B2) and **absolute** (`$F$1`)
  references.
- SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, MIN; SUMIF and COUNTIF with a rule.
- Sort, filter, conditional formatting; column, line and pie charts.
- Prices with tax: `=B2*(1+$F$1)`, copied down.

![Relative and absolute references.](../week-06/images/references.png){width=92%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
A typed result does not change when the numbers change. Use a formula.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Lab task · Prices with tax"}
Type five prices and 16 % in F1. Make the column *with tax* with one formula
copied down, the total with SUM, and a column chart with a title.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 4 · Excel"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="=B2\*F2|=SUM"}
B2 = 3, C2 = 7. What does =B2\*C2 show?
:   21

You copy =B2\*\$F\$1 from C2 to C4. What is in C4?
:   =B4\*\$F\$1

Which function counts the cells greater than 20?
:   COUNTIF

Which chart shows a change over time?
:   a line chart
:::
:::

## Game challenge: Huda's Busy Day {.challenge}

Work alone. Use every section of today.

Huda, the office manager of the **Sunrise Company**, has a new job every
hour: a file name, a share link, an AI notice and its check, a contents
page, two Excel formulas and a chart.

{{< sim file="sims/huda-day.html" poster="sims/huda-day.png" title="Huda's Busy Day: one job every hour" kind="game" height="560" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 5 · Huda's jobs"}
Choose the best way.

::: {.match extra="send it as it is|bold and big"}
The AI notice has a wrong fact.
:   correct it before sending

Ten headings and a contents page.
:   Heading 1 and Heading 2 styles

A tax rate in F1 for every row.
:   =B2\*\$F\$1

The sales from Sunday to Thursday.
:   a line chart
:::
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 6 · Five checks (harder)"}
Before Huda hands in her work, she checks five things. Choose the right
check.

![Five checks.](images/five-checks.png){width=92%}

::: {.match extra="the colour of the file|the size of the screen"}
Is the file easy to find?
:   the name and the folder

Is the AI text true?
:   check the facts

Does the report look right?
:   styles, numbers and a title

Can the right people open it?
:   the share link and its rights
:::
:::

## Summary {.summary}

- Files: good names, folders, sync is not a backup, share only with the
  right people.
- AI: task, context, format; check every answer; no personal data.
- Word: styles, header and footer, a table of contents.
- Excel: formulas, $ references, functions, sort, filter, rules and the
  right chart.
